fields.description: The master switch. When off, the webhook still answers Periskope (so it does not retry) but nothing is stored.
fields.label: Enable Periskope Integration

fields.description: Paste the API key from Periskope (console.periskope.app > Settings > Integrations > API). It is shown only once, so keep a copy. Then use Actions > Test Connection.
fields.label: Periskope API Key
Webhook URL to Add in Periskope

fields.description: Paste the signing secret from Periskope (Settings > Webhooks). The webhook itself is created for you by Test Connection or Actions > Create Webhook in Periskope; the secret is the one part Periskope does not return through its API.
fields.label: Webhook Signing Secret

fields.description: The events Periskope should send to this site. Only message.created is stored as a message; the others are logged. Test Connection or Create Webhook in Periskope registers them.
fields.label: Webhook Events

fields.description: Direct API sends messages to Anthropic (or Z.ai) with your own key. Jarvis (shown only when the Jarvis app is installed) uses the model already set up there, so no key is needed here.
fields.label: AI Provider

fields.description: Paste the API key of your AI provider: Anthropic (console.anthropic.com) for Claude models, or Z.ai for GLM models. Message text is sent to that provider to be tagged. Then use Actions > Test AI Connection. For GLM, also set AI API Address under AI Options to https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic.
fields.label: AI API Key

fields.label: Earlier Messages Given to the AI

fields.description: When the AI tags a customer's message in a 1-to-1 chat as New Enquiry and the number is not on any lead or deal, a CRM Lead is created for the rep of that phone. Every unknown number appears in the Periskope Contact queue either way, where a manager can create or link a lead with one click.
fields.label: Create Leads from New Enquiries

fields.description: One WhatsApp number per line (with country code). Personal, staff and vendor numbers here get no Contact queue entry and no lead.
fields.label: Ignore List

fields.description: Numbers found on an ERPNext Supplier's contact are ignored (needs ERPNext).
fields.label: Ignore Supplier Numbers

fields.description: Numbers found on an ERPNext Employee record are ignored (needs ERPNext).
fields.label: Ignore Employee Numbers

fields.description: Who gets the daily email of new unmatched contacts (comma-separated). Empty uses the Manager Emails on the Reply Reminders tab.
fields.label: Digest Recipients
Remind Reps When a Customer Is Waiting
Working Days
fields.options:
Monday to Saturday
Monday to Friday
Every day

fields.description: Holidays (for example the Diwali shutdown) do not count as waiting time.
fields.label: Holiday List

fields.description: Who is emailed at L3 (comma-separated). Empty uses the Manager Emails.
fields.label: Escalation Emails (L3, the MD)

fields.description: What happens, and when, for a customer who is waiting for a reply. Rows run in order of waiting time; each action runs once per waiting period.
fields.label: SLA Levels

fields.description: Comma-separated words that close a conversation ('ok', 'sari', 'seri', ...). Added to the built-in list.
fields.label: Acknowledgement Words

fields.description: Checked on every incoming text message, independent of the AI. A rule sends nothing until it has recipients.
fields.label: Keyword Rules

fields.description: Two matches of the same rule in the same chat within this many hours send one alert.
fields.label: Dedupe Window (hours)

fields.description: Reply budget per classification. 400 fits the JSON answer with room; raise it (e.g. 4096) only for reasoning models.
fields.label: Max Tokens per AI Call

fields.description: Messages shorter than this are never sent to the AI.
fields.label: Minimum Message Length

fields.description: Total tokens per calendar month. When reached, tagging pauses and the managers get an email. 0 = no budget.
fields.label: Monthly Token Budget

fields.description: The raw webhook payload of a message is cleared after this many days (0 = keep forever).
fields.label: Keep Raw Payload (days)

fields.description: Message text is cleared after this many days (0 = keep forever). Links, tags and summaries stay either way.
fields.label: Keep Message Text (days)

fields.description: Save WhatsApp attachments (images, documents, voice notes) as private Frappe Files, so they survive Periskope's expiring media paths.
fields.label: Download Attachments
WhatsApp in the Lead and Deal Timeline

fields.description: 'One per message' adds a comment to the lead or deal for every classified, non-general message. 'Burst' merges messages of the same chat within the window into one growing comment. 'Off' adds no comments.
fields.label: Timeline Comments

fields.description: Let reps read the WhatsApp messages of the company numbers assigned to them in the phones table. Managers always see everything. Off keeps reps out (the pilot default).
fields.label: Reps See Their Own Numbers
Learning Agent
fields.description: A background agent reads new conversations, builds the knowledge base and suggests changes to the tags, keyword rules, SLA levels and settings. Nothing is applied until a manager approves it.

fields.label: First Look-back (days)
fields.description: How far back the agent reads the first time it runs

fields.label: Minimum Evidence
fields.description: A suggestion must be based on at least this many messages

fields.label: Approval Emails
fields.description: Who gets the Approve / Reject emails. Empty means the Manager Emails.

fields.label: Hours Between Emails
fields.description: New suggestions are sent together, not one email each

fields.label: Enable Auto Reply
fields.description: Reply to customers from the system's data after a delay. Off means no message is ever sent by the app.

fields.label: Reply Delay (minutes)
fields.description: Wait this long after the customer's last message

fields.label: Random Variation (%)
fields.description: Adds up to this much extra delay so replies do not look robotic

fields.label: Minimum Confidence
fields.description: Below this the holding message is sent instead of an answer

fields.label: Max Replies per Chat per Day
